info.name: BTC War Live Market Data API

description.content:
Read-only, machine-verifiable snapshots of nine Binance Spot markets quoted in USDT. BTC War exposes venue-specific observations with source timestamps, provenance, freshness and limitations; it does not provide consolidated global prices, predictions, trading signals or financial advice. This bundled representation contains no remote JSON Schema references for importers that cannot dereference external URLs.

 Name: BTC War
